cases.name: copy-one
cases.covers: One annotation copied onto its own page, where it was: a new object with the source's data, a name of its own, no links. The refMap maps the source to its copy.

cases.name: copy-moved-by-an-offset
cases.covers: The offset is in page points from the top-left: x to the right, y down.

cases.name: a-reply-copied-with-its-parent-replies-to-its-copy
cases.covers: The anchor and two replies (one a reply, one a group member): the copies form a group of their own, each reply replying to the anchor's copy with the same type.

cases.name: a-reply-copied-alone-stands-alone
cases.covers: A reply whose parent is not copied loses its link.

cases.name: an-unsupported-kind-is-dropped
cases.covers: A kind the engine does not model is left out, and dropped names it; the rest is copied.

cases.name: a-reversed-rect-refuses-the-copy
cases.covers: Annotation 6 has its /Rect corners the other way round and reads with a negative width, which its create schema refuses: the whole change is refused with InvalidArg before the first write.

cases.name: one-named-twice-is-copied-twice
cases.covers: Named twice, copied twice; the refMap has it twice.

cases.name: the-copies-take-the-numbers-given
cases.covers: objectNumbers names each copy, in the order of the refs.

cases.name: copies-on-another-page
cases.covers: With page, the copies go on that page (a blank page the same change inserts at object 60), the same spot from its top-left, moved by the offset; a reply copied with its parent still replies to its copy there.

cases.name: a-page-the-document-lacks-is-refused
cases.covers: A page no page has refuses the copy before anything is read.

cases.name: an-unknown-annotation-is-refused
cases.covers: A ref no annotation has refuses the change.

cases.name: an-undo-takes-the-copies-away
cases.covers: The undo deletes the copies; the page reads as it did.
